records.jp: へぇ～、今度新しくショッピングモールできるんだ
records.en_original: Huh, looks like they're building a new mall.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, looks like they're building a new mall.
records.en: Huh, they're opening a new shopping mall soon.

records.jp: （チア部すごいなぁ。<CR>あんな高いところで演技して）
records.en_original: (The cheerleading club sure is amazing... Don't they get scared being held so high?)
records.en_auxiliary: (The cheerleading club sure is amazing... Don't they get scared being held so high?)
records.en: (The cheerleading club is amazing.<CR>Performing way up that high...)

records.jp: うわ、日本初上陸「飲むクレープ」かぁ
records.en_original: Whoa, this is new. Drinkable crepes.
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa, this is new. Drinkable crepes.
records.en: Whoa, 'drinkable crepes' are making their Japanese debut.

records.jp: 何それ？
records.en_original: What the heck is that?
records.en_auxiliary: What the heck is that?
records.en: What's that?

records.jp: ベースはシェイクみたいな感じで、<CR>細かく刻んだクレープ生地が入ってるんだって
records.en_original: I guess it's a milkshake, but they mix it with a bunch of cut up crepes.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess it's a milkshake, but they mix it with a bunch of cut up crepes.
records.en: It says the base is like a shake,<CR>with finely chopped crepe mixed in.

records.jp: 飲みづらそう
records.en_original: That sounds...weird.
records.en_auxiliary: That sounds...weird.
records.en: Sounds hard to drink.

records.jp: いや、ミキサーにかけることによって<CR>新たな発見があるかもしれない！
records.en_original: No way, imagine all of the possibilities!
records.en_auxiliary: No way, imagine all of the possibilities!
records.en: No, blending it all together<CR>might lead to a whole new discovery!

records.jp: ほら、このいちご入ってるのとか<CR>よさそうじゃない？
records.en_original: Look, doesn't this strawberry one sound good?
records.en_auxiliary: Look, doesn't this strawberry one sound good?
records.en: Look, doesn't this strawberry one<CR>sound good?

records.jp: 見せて
records.en_original: Show me.
records.en_auxiliary: Show me.
records.en: Let me see.

records.jp: ふーん、美味しそう
records.en_original: Huh, looks good to me.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, looks good to me.
records.en: Hmm, it looks delicious.

records.jp: ねぇ、開店したら行ってみようよ
records.en_original: Let's go and try one when they open!
records.en_auxiliary: Let's go and try one when they open!
records.en: Hey, let's go when it opens.

records.jp: それはいいかな
records.en_original: I don't know about that.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know about that.
records.en: I think I'll pass.

records.jp: えー、なんで？
records.en_original: Whaaat? Why?
records.en_auxiliary: Whaaat? Why?
records.en: What? Why?

records.jp: だってすごく並びそうだし
records.en_original: I bet we'd have to wait in line forever.
records.en_auxiliary: I bet we'd have to wait in line forever.
records.en: Because it'll probably have a huge line.

records.jp: 評判が定まってからの方が<CR>失敗しないで済むし
records.en_original: Wouldn't it be smarter to go after we hear if it's any good or not?
records.en_auxiliary: Wouldn't it be smarter to go after we hear if it's any good or not?
records.en: If we wait until people agree whether it's good,<CR>we're less likely to regret going.

records.jp: それもそうか……<CR>うむむ、とりあえず様子見かな
records.en_original: I guess so... Mmm, fine I guess we'll wait.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess so... Mmm, fine I guess we'll wait.
records.en: That's true...<CR>Hmm, I guess we'll wait and see for now.

records.jp: それより、ユズにはこっちの方がいいんじゃない？
records.en_original: Actually, wouldn't you rather go somewhere like this?
records.en_auxiliary: Actually, wouldn't you rather go somewhere like this?
records.en: Besides, Yuzu, wouldn't this be more your thing?

records.jp: チョコレートショップ！？<CR>これはチェックしないと
records.en_original: A chocolatier?! Oh, I gotta check this place out.
records.en_auxiliary: A chocolatier?! Oh, I gotta check this place out.
records.en: A chocolate shop?!<CR>I have to check this out.

records.jp: （お、あれはバレエのリフトに似てるかも）
records.en_original: (Oh, that looked a lot like the lifts in ballet.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Oh, that looked a lot like the lifts in ballet.)
records.en: (Oh, that might be similar to a ballet lift.)

records.jp: そっか。<CR>こういう感じでいいんだ
records.en_original: That's right. That's what it was like.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right. That's what it was like.
records.en: I see.<CR>So this is enough.

records.jp: 無理に相手に合わせないで、したいことをして<CR>話したい時に話して
records.en_original: I didn't try to keep up with anyone. I did whatever I felt like, talked whenever I wanted to...
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't try to keep up with anyone. I did whatever I felt like, talked whenever I wanted to...
records.en: I don't have to force myself to match the other person. I can just do what I want<CR>and talk whenever I feel like it.

records.jp: それでも寂しくなかった。<CR>満たされてた
records.en_original: And I never felt lonely. I was happy.
records.en_auxiliary: And I never felt lonely. I was happy.
records.en: Even then, I wasn't lonely.<CR>I felt fulfilled.

records.jp: 何かを一緒にやることが大事だと思ってたけど、<CR>そうじゃなくて
records.en_original: I used to think that the important thing was doing things together.
records.en_auxiliary: I used to think that the important thing was doing things together.
records.en: I thought doing something together was what mattered,<CR>but that's not it.

records.jp: 一緒に過ごしててどう感じるかってことが<CR>大事なんだ
records.en_original: But the important thing is how you feel when you're together.
records.en_auxiliary: But the important thing is how you feel when you're together.
records.en: What matters is how you feel<CR>while you're spending time together.

records.jp: 私は“普通”になれる？
records.en_original: Do you really think that you can be normal?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you really think that you can be normal?
records.en: Can I become "normal"?

records.jp: ならなくていい。<CR>無理になろうとしなくていい
records.en_original: I don't need to be. I don't need to try so hard.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't need to be. I don't need to try so hard.
records.en: I don't need to.<CR>I don't need to force myself to become "normal."

records.jp: “普通”にならなくたって、<CR>みんなと理解し合うことはできるから
records.en_original: We don't all need to be the same in order to understand each other.
records.en_auxiliary: We don't all need to be the same in order to understand each other.
records.en: Even if I don't become "normal,"<CR>I can still come to understand everyone.

records.jp: ってことは、愛央との過ごし方も<CR>あんな感じでよかったんだ
records.en_original: Which means that the time I spent with Ao was perfect the way it was.
records.en_auxiliary: Which means that the time I spent with Ao was perfect the way it was.
records.en: Then the way I spent time with Ao<CR>was fine after all.

records.jp: えっ、それって……
records.en_original: You really mean it...?
records.en_auxiliary: You really mean it...?
records.en: Huh? Does that mean...

records.jp: 愛央もそうだった？
records.en_original: You felt that way too, didn't you, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: You felt that way too, didn't you, Ao?
records.en: Did you feel the same way, Ao?

records.jp: 言わなきゃわかんない？
records.en_original: Do I really have to spell it out for you?
records.en_auxiliary: Do I really have to spell it out for you?
records.en: Do I have to say it for you to understand?

records.jp: 寝てたくらいだもんね
records.en_original: All you did was nap the whole time.
records.en_auxiliary: All you did was nap the whole time.
records.en: You were asleep, after all.

records.jp: えへへ
records.en_original: Teehee.
records.en_auxiliary: Teehee.
records.en: Ehehe.

records.jp: （“普通”も“特別”も根本は変わらない）
records.en_original: ("Special" and "normal" is all relative.)
records.en_auxiliary: ("Special" and "normal" is all relative.)
records.en: (At the core, "normal" and "special" aren't any different.)

records.jp: （私たちはそのままで分かり合える）
records.en_original: (We can understand each other just the way we are.)
records.en_auxiliary: (We can understand each other just the way we are.)
records.en: (We can understand each other just as we are.)
